messages:
Maya: Quick idea — can we try a compact weekly triage (30m) focused on unblockers + fast owner updates? Trying to cut the long 60m down.
Tom: +1 on shorter. saves a lot of context-switch time.
Ava: curious — mon mornings work best for US, but EMEA folks flag clashing.
Maya: proposal: Mondays 10:00-10:30 PT, alternating hosts. Agenda: blockers, 3 owner updates, quick bug queue sweep, infra flags.
Ravi: pinging @Sasha for infra compatibility — we had some long infra topics last time.
Sasha: I can surface infra-only items to the infra async thread. For triage, please tag anything that needs >15m as "deep-dive" so we don't blow the 30m.
Maya: nice — add a label: `triage:deep-dive`. If present we auto-schedule a follow-up.
Tom: also suggest biweekly one deep-dive slot in the 30m (first 10m), otherwise keep it blocked.
Maya: draft agenda text (for calendar invite):
```
Title: Eng Triage — Compact (30m)
When: Mondays 10:00-10:30 PT
Guests: eng-team
Agenda:
- 5m: Quick blockers (owner flags)
- 12m: Owner updates (3 owners x ~4m)
- 8m: Bug queue triage (prioritize 1-2 items)
- 5m: Infra / ops flags and follow-ups
Notes: Tag issues with `triage:deep-dive` for follow-up scheduling.
```
Ava: calendar text looks good. would like one monthly alternate for EMEA (repeat at 17:00 CET) — ok to run as a second, opt-in session?
Maya: we'll keep the core session at 10:00 PT and run an optional monthly repeat for EMEA. I'll schedule the repeat as the last Monday of the month.
Jordan: small ask — can owners be auto-rotated? manual picks are ok but automation avoids missed pings.
Maya: good call. I'll add a tiny rota file in the eng handbook and set a reminder.
Maya: owner rotation plan (next 4 weeks): week1 @Matt, week2 @Ana, week3 @Ravi, week4 @Sasha.
Matt: noted, I'll own week1.
Ana: noted, will prepare a 3-bullet update each week.
Ravi: noted. I'll push any infra heavy stuff to the infra thread first.
triage-bot: Tip: use `/assign-owner @name` in the triage channel to attach owner metadata to the meeting thread.
Maya: Also request — people should post very short pre-reads in the thread if they need >2m. Keeps meeting lean.
Tom: agreed — pre-reads or a single line summary.
Sasha: I'll update infra ops doc with the `triage:deep-dive` workflow and short checklist for post-triage follow-ups.
Maya: I'll post the calendar invites and update the eng handbook tomorrow.
Jordan: :thumbsup: thanks for tightening this up.
Maya: final note — switching to compact triage starts next Monday. If anyone has blocking conflicts, shout here and I'll shuffle. :white_check_mark:
